entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: All right, that was a great performance[n]by the dance club!

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Everybody give them another[n]round of applause!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Their effort is being ignored... and yet[n]they continue to give it their all.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: That's today's youth for you, I guess.
You're right.
It's all fruitless effort.
You're quite dignified.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: That includes you, because you're still[n]young.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Maybe... But those who work hard will be[n]appreciated one day.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Didn't I just sound like a good teacher?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: What!?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Anyway, about what Akechi-kun said[n]earlier...

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: And now, it's time for your[n]favorite Shujin tradition:[n]the Student Sharing Special!

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Round of applause, everyone!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Wanna go someplace where we can[n]be alone? There's something I want to[n]talk to you about.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Enjoy the post-festival party. Just stop by[n]the students' association room when[n]you're done.

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: All right, who has something to say?[n]Anyone, anyone!?

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: No? I'll just have to pick someone then!

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: How about...

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: The good sir over there!
Unfortunately, that's me...

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Well then, come on up!
I'll pass.
I have a headache.

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Now, now! You're not shy, are you!?

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: He's either a carefree spirit who does as[n]he pleases or an airhead who's oblivious[n]to the situation!
I should go see Kawakami...

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: All right, now that the audience is[n]warmed up...

entries.speaker: Post-Festival MC
entries.en: Let's move on to our next participant!
